mathematical_object: Three independent angle-uniform points on a unit-circle arc of moving half-span approaching 2pi/3 at the square-root area-deficit scale.
scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of exact geometric maximum, locally uniform critical-window limit and total-variation conditional shape law; independent external audit has not occurred. Numerical checker only corroborates finite examples.
scientific_limitations: Only three angle-uniform points on the unit circle
Arc half-span L approaches 2pi/3 as lambda*sqrt(epsilon), with lambda fixed or in compact sets
No multi-sample maximum, full-area distribution or uniformity for diverging lambda
title: A moving-arc critical-window law for nearly maximal random cyclic triangles
